sql: CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW ad_platform WITH CONTAINER kola AS SELECT r.month AS month, r.city AS city, r.platform AS platform, CAST(r.spend_ngn AS DOUBLE) AS spend_ngn, CAST(r.impressions AS BIGINT) AS impressions, CAST(r.clicks AS BIGINT) AS clicks FROM kola_systems.ad_platform_src LATERAL VIEW explode(records) AS r
